headline.caveat: >$100B of AWS purchases over a decade, incl. up to 5GW of capacity on Trainium 2/3/4 and future generations plus tens of millions of Graviton cores

realized_to_date.caveat: Anthropic has consumed AWS/Trainium at scale since 2024 (Project Rainier ~1GW live 2025); cumulative spend not disclosed

nature_md: Announced Apr 20, 2026 alongside Amazon's $5B (+ up to $20B) investment: Anthropic commits to **more than $100B of AWS technology purchases over ten years**, securing up to 5GW of capacity — significant Trainium3 in 2026, plus Trainium2/4 and rights to future silicon generations and Graviton CPU fleets — with international inference expansion in Asia and Europe. Builds on Project Rainier (the ~1GW Trainium2 training cluster live in 2025). AWS remains Anthropic's primary training partner even as Anthropic runs a deliberate three-cloud strategy (Google TPUs, Azure). The equity and the commitment were struck together — the round-trip is explicit in the announcement itself.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Decade-scale purchase commitment expensed as consumed — Anthropic's largest single forward obligation, payable from revenue growth (run-rate $9B Dec 2025 → $30B+ mid-2026) and continued fundraising. Terms (minimums, take-or-pay) undisclosed.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: AWS books consumption revenue and the commitment feeds backlog (~$496B mid-2026). Because Amazon's equity funds the same counterparty whose purchases it books, a slice of AWS growth is self-referential — though Anthropic's third-party revenue increasingly covers the spend.

events.title: Anthropic commits >$100B/decade to AWS incl. up to 5GW Trainium
